title: لكل رائحة حكاية — edited AR
message: هذا تصور إبداعي تجريبي يستلهم المعلومات المعتمدة عن منتجات Lavish Perfumes، ولا يثبت اتجاهات سوقية أو نتائج استخدام.

shots.visual: On an ivory field, place the approved LAVISH OUD original image at 55% frame width without repainting the bottle or obscuring its label. Slow 2D push-in within safe crop; generous text margin in upper negative space. Arabic creative version: use right-to-left text alignment and native font, preserve Latin product and brand names.
shots.transition: Cut from black; fade in text over 180ms.

shots.visual: Editorial two-panel composition: approved LAVISH OUD image left, approved PERLA 50ML UNISEX image right. Introduce panels via restrained horizontal wipe; no visual implying actual mixing or test results. Arabic creative version: use right-to-left text alignment and native font, preserve Latin product and brand names.
shots.transition: Soft 180ms cross-dissolve on shot boundary; product marks remain stable.

shots.visual: Balanced side-by-side composition of the two original product photos; use only 2D pan and cross-dissolve, respecting each original aspect ratio and legible packaging. Keep the visual exploratory, not instructional. Arabic creative version: use right-to-left text alignment and native font, preserve Latin product and brand names.
shots.transition: Soft 180ms cross-dissolve on shot boundary; product marks remain stable.

shots.visual: Set approved square Lavish logo intact in its own square tile over a matte ivory backdrop, with unobstructed CTA beneath in readable type. Do not stretch or key out the opaque gold logo. Arabic creative version: use right-to-left text alignment and native font, preserve Latin product and brand names.
shots.transition: Hold final composition and fade to matte at exactly 15000ms.

caption: تصور إبداعي توضيحي لعلامة Lavish Perfumes، وليس دليلاً على اتجاه سوقي فعلي أو نتيجة استخدام مؤكدة.
